name: Unite All Schools
description: Unite All Schools gives teachers and students opportunities to grow as global citizen leaders, working on real-life projects with peers from diverse countries through innovative virtual exchange programmes. Students and teachers build the problem-solving, collaboration and leadership skills to tackle local and global challenges together.
terms: A confirmation email is sent to your registered email or phone number after you donate.
termsList: A confirmation email is sent to your registered email or phone number after you donate.
Donations are non-refundable and cannot be cancelled.
The charity's receipt is delivered directly by the donation supplier within 45 to 60 days.
This donation does not provide any tax benefit, so no tax certificate is issued.
